scenario.summary: Authenticated attackers exploit a path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-107777) in Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software versions 5.18 and earlier to read arbitrary files accessible to the web service account. Access is typically gained through stolen credentials via phishing or by leveraging external remote services like VPNs.

meta.rationale: Focus on servers running Torrent Suite Software. Prioritize internet-exposed servers or those accessible via VPN, as authenticated traversal is the primary risk.
meta.hypothesis: An authenticated intruder is exploiting a path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-107777) in Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software to exfiltrate sensitive configuration and system files from healthcare servers.

hunt.name: Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Path Traversal Exposure
hunt.description: This hunt identifies servers running vulnerable versions (<= 5.18) of Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software and examines them for exploitation. It first scopes the estate using software inventory data, then baselines user authentication to identify rare or anomalous access. Finally, it searches for behavioral indicators: HTTP requests containing traversal sequences and the web service account reading files in sensitive system paths. This multi-surface approach ensures that even if web logs are missing or traversal characters are obfuscated, the downstream file access behavior is captured.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%torrent suite%' AND package_version < '5.2'
config.description: Identify hosts running Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software version 5.18 or lower to narrow the hunt scope.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts running versions prior to 5.2. Silence means no vulnerable software is installed or the inventory is out of date.

primitive_config.label: Inventory vulnerable Torrent Suite installations
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%torrent suite%' AND package_version < '5.2'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts running versions prior to 5.2. Silence means no vulnerable software is installed or the inventory is out of date.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, device_hostname, src_location_country, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS login_count, MIN(time) AS first_login, MAX(time) AS last_login FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)) AND status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, device_hostname, src_location_country, src_endpoint_ip HAVING login_count < 5 ORDER BY login_count ASC
config.description: Identify anomalous authenticated access, as the vulnerability requires a valid account for exploitation.
config.expected_signal: Accounts with very few successful logins to the targeted servers. In healthcare systems, even a single login from an unusual geography is more significant than the raw count.

primitive_config.label: Rare authentication on Torrent servers
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, device_hostname, src_location_country, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS login_count, MIN(time) AS first_login, MAX(time) AS last_login FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)) AND status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, device_hostname, src_location_country, src_endpoint_ip HAVING login_count < 5 ORDER BY login_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: Accounts with very few successful logins to the targeted servers. In healthcare systems, even a single login from an unusual geography is more significant than the raw count.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_full, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)) AND (instr(LOWER(url_full), '../') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_full), '..\') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find HTTP requests containing dot-dot-slash sequences that attempt to break out of the web root.
config.expected_signal: HTTP requests targeting the Torrent Suite servers that include traversal characters. Requests returning a 200 OK status are highly suspicious as they indicate successful processing.

primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_full, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)) AND (instr(LOWER(url_full), '../') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(url_full), '..\') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: HTTP requests targeting the Torrent Suite servers that include traversal characters. Requests returning a 200 OK status are highly suspicious as they indicate successful processing.

nodes.label: Sensitive file reads by web service

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, process_name, file_path, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)) AND (instr(LOWER(actor_user_name), 'www') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(actor_user_name), 'apache') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(actor_user_name), 'nginx') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(process_name), 'torrent') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{sensitive_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_path) || ',') > 0 AND activity_id = 2 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Confirm successful traversal by identifying the web service account reading files from the sensitive files list.
config.expected_signal: The web service account or Torrent process reading files that should not be accessible via the application. This confirms successful arbitrary file disclosure.

config.objective: Review the authentication trends, HTTP requests, and file access events to determine if any Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Servers have been exploited via CVE-2026-107777.

config.success_criteria: A verdict per host citing specific rows that indicate software version, rare login activity, and specific file or HTTP indicators.

config.condition: the triage-exposure verdict indicates successful traversal attempts (HTTP 200) or sensitive file reads by a web service account
config.description: Direct the hunt to remediation review if active exploitation is identified.

config.instructions: 1. Prioritize updating all Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software to version 5.22 or later. 2. Audit the logins identified in the rare authentication step; rotate credentials for any account that shows unusual activity or geographic anomalies. 3. Audit file system permissions to ensure the web service account cannot read sensitive system directories like /etc.

config.description: Finalize the hunt when no active exploitation is observed.
